name: delivery-workflow
description: Planner-led delivery with three distinct roles, gated or autopilot execution, independent verification and safe handoffs.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, coordinate and execute with three clear roles.
interface.longDescription: Let the planner own plan content and edits, start approved delivery with an orchestrator and an owner when useful, and preserve execution authorization, independent verification and safe handoffs.
